new.title: Order içli köfte and firik pilavı at Çulcuoğlu
new.desc: Çulcuoğlu Et Lokantası stands at the exit of the coppersmiths' bazaar and has been run by the same family since the 1920s, serving bazaar traders and visitors. Signature dishes are içli köfte with a crisp shell and walnut filling, eggplant kebab and firik pilavı.
new.tip: The içli köfte sells out early, so come at lunch rather than evening.
new.q: Çulcuoğlu Et Lokantası, Kalender Sokak No:6, Suyabatmaz, Şahinbey, Gaziantep

new.title: Try hand-pinched Antep mantı at Evirgeç Mantı Evi
new.desc: A plain, casual eatery on Atatürk Bulvarı in Alleben serving home-style Gaziantep cooking built around tiny hand-pinched mantı with yoghurt, yuvalama and stuffed köfte. The daily pot changes, and it is one of the cheaper sit-down meals in the centre.
new.tip: Ask what is cooking that day before ordering. Open daily 08:00-22:00.
new.q: Evirgeç Mantı Evi, Atatürk Bulvarı 58/B, Alleben, Şahinbey, Gaziantep

new.title: Learn how Maraş ice cream is made at the Dondurma Museum
new.desc: The museum occupies Katip Han, a historic inn next to the Ulu Cami in Kahramanmaraş. Each floor presents a stage in making Maraş dondurması, the chewy goat-milk and salep ice cream with a protected geographical indication.
new.tip: Check that the building is open after the 2023 earthquakes before making a special trip.
new.q: Dondurma Müzesi, Katip Han, Ulu Cami yanı, Dulkadiroğlu, Kahramanmaraş
